note: Single source of truth for the left sidebar and the client-side search. Every new page adds exactly one entry to pages[]. url is relative to the site root. question is the generic form of the customer question; variants are other wordings of the same question, so a differently worded ticket still finds this page.

pages.title: Getting Started: First Launch to First Model
pages.question: We have just bought Tekla Structures and I am the first one in the office to install it. On the first start it asks me to sign in, then asks about environment, role and configuration, and I do not know what to pick. How do I get to my first model?
variants: What do I choose for environment, role and configuration on the first start?
No license appears when I sign in to Tekla Structures.
Which desktop icon should I use, the classic startup screen or Tekla Launcher?
How do I create my very first model?
pages.summary: Onboarding a new customer - Trimble Identity and subscription, the classic startup screen vs Tekla Launcher, choosing environment, role and configuration, and creating the first model.

pages.title: Drawings Not Updating After Model Changes
pages.question: We changed parts in the model, but the drawings still show the old geometry and the dimensions have not moved. Some of them will not open at all. We already unlocked the drawings and it made no difference. Is this a bug?
variants: Why are my drawings not updating after I modify the model?
Dimensions and marks do not follow the parts after a model change.
Tekla says the drawing is not up to date and will not let me open it.
We unlocked the drawing and it still shows the old geometry.
pages.summary: Why a drawing still shows old geometry, dimensions or marks after a model revision - numbering, freeze vs lock, recreation, and the advanced options that switch automatic updating off.
